subject.name: Wind Energy Operations Managers
subject.summary: The wind energy operations manager corresponds to O*NET11-9199.09 and manages the staff, maintenance, finances, and plans of continuous wind farm operation. The work includes operations and maintenance records, downtime and spare parts tracking, budgets and costs, contracts and warranties, training, and subcontractor supervision. Responsibility scopes differ by unit; development managers focus on opportunities and project preliminaries, engineers on design and analysis, and service technicians on specific equipment tasks, and an operations management title does not automatically grant electrical, height, or dispatch work authority.
